:::{#cor-logistic-slope}

#### Derivative of the probability with respect to the predictor

In the single-predictor logistic regression model of @eq-unipredictor-logreg:

$$
\derivf{\prob}{x}
= \pi (1-\pi) \beta
= \Varf{Y|X=x} \cdot \beta
$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-logistic-slope, worked in @sol-logistic-slope.

:::
